title: Cover the queued bind idempotency key across a replay and a settlement, and align the card's fence latency clocks
outcome:
Two parts:
(1) A focused test proves that the queued bind idempotency key, which now includes the owner's dispatch generation (src/engram_queued_admission.rs ~:1320), stays the same across a replay at the same generation and changes after a settlement moves the generation.
(2) The card's preparation_fence_ms and admission_fence_ms are measured on the same clock and around only their durability waits, or the doc states what each span covers.
acceptance: Cover the queued bind idempotency key across a replay and a settlement, and align the card's fence latency clocks is done
